sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Dull, heavy, confused, dizzy. Heat of face
and headache, with general coldness. Headache, with
affections of respiratory organs.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Sensation of weight, of fullness; bor-
borygmi; abundant emission of wind. Colic in early
morning, abdomen tense, relieved somewhat by evacua-
tion and passing of wind.

sections.label: Chest
sections.text:
Difficult breathing. Suffocative breathing*
from dropsy of the chest. Constant tickling cough. In-
cessant, spasmodic cough, as if chest would fly to pieces.
Squeezing sensation in lower chest.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Promotes catamenia. Increase of milk in
breasts.

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Restless; impossible to get to sleep. Deep,
comatose sleep.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Coldness and numbness of feet and
legs. Tremor of hands and arms.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Antidotes: Acet. ar.; Coff.
